schemeScope: Combined Paper 1 and Paper 2 scheme. PDF 1–2 cover and note; 3 listening tariffs (and the only print of the 0–3 language deduction); 4–6 listening transcript (never shown to students); 7–11 listening answers, ending with the cover-mark table; 12–16 composition marking, Stíl/Ábhar/Gaeilge bands and the short / off-title reductions; 50 modified marking (SMM). PDF 17–49 are Paper 2; 51–52 blank.
reviewMethod: Every paper page (the 2021 Paper 1 is an 8-page question booklet; page 8 is blank) and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page; each listening prompt and scheme slice is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

nonPoolDecisions: Listening: “Scríobh síos dhá …/Tabhair dhá …/Luaigh dhá …” asks for two points at 2 + 2; the scheme lists more accepted points than required. These are answer keys for one task, not task routes.

Card unit for listening: the eight retained legacy segment cards (Fógra, Mír, Píosa) keep their IDs and stay the card unit, because the Bank plays one recording section as one exercise; every printed question is a separate criterion at its published 2 or 2 + 2 tariff (23 questions, 60 marks). Separate question cards are not added: they would repeat the same prompts inside that exercise.

Composition: A–C is a closed choose-one; the nine printed titles were already carded as their own cards (live IDs retained). AISTE nó ALT (form) and the debate stance (ar son nó ina aghaidh) stay inside one response.
The modified marking scheme changes assessment for eligible candidates, not the printed tasks.
sourceFindings: Paper 1 = 160: Cuid I listening 60 (Cuid A 18 = Fógra 1 8 + Fógra 2 10; Cuid B 28 = Comhrá 1 14 (Mír 1 8 + Mír 2 6) + Comhrá 2 14 (Mír 1 8 + Mír 2 6); Cuid C 14 = Píosa 1 6 + Píosa 2 8), every question 2 marks or 2 + 2; Cuid II composition 100 (choose one of A, B, C).
Listening language: “Bainfear ó 0 go 3 ar chaighdeán na Gaeilge” is printed only on scheme PDF 3 in 2021; it is one section-level deduction, and each card states it without applying it.

The 2021 listening answers carry no annotation-symbol table; PDF 11 closes with the cover-mark table (“Léirigh na marcanna mar seo ar chlúdach na Cluastuisceana”), which is not part of any answer key.
Composition: 2021 prints no S1–S4 grades; PDF 16 prints the reductions for an attempt that is too short or partly off-title (Stíl 4/3/2, Ábhar 13/11/9, Gaeilge 68/56/44). No S4 title applies.
The paper prints the composition Treoracha on page 6 and the choice, length note and titles on page 7; the composition cards show both pages.

Legacy corrections (IDs, totals and topics unchanged): each segment card had one undivided criterion; the nine composition cards carried the 2021–2022 legacy composition text. All now carry the lifted 2021 scheme text and per-question tariffs.
